Genshin Impact.status: All currently planned Bento Genshin regions through Nod-Krai are represented; game content remains isolated behind Games.

animeLibraries.navigation: Compact Anime series dropdown with All Anime plus per-series recipe counts.
animeLibraries.isolation: Anime records are excluded from Cuisines, Meals, Desserts, Drinks, standard cuisine counts, Kitchen Magic, Cook With pantry matching, and generic automatic recommendations.

photoStrategy: Standard cuisine recipes use real online food photography from Wikimedia Commons. Genshin and Anime use source-world artwork/search only and never fall through to unrelated IRL food photography.
navigation: Cuisines, Meals, Desserts and Drinks use compact selectors; Games and Anime remain dedicated icon tabs.
gameIsolation: Game recipes are excluded from ordinary cuisine/meal/dessert/drink and automatic recommendation surfaces.
animeIsolation: Anime recipes are discoverable only under Anime unless directly opened/saved/planned; search inside Anime indexes anime series, episode, dish and adaptation metadata.
cuisineNavigation: Compact cuisine selector sourced from the full standard library, including user-created cuisines.
cacheFix: v25.0 uses the 25p1 shell generation and caches the Japanese/Filipino expansion plus every recipe QA/content layer.
performance: Recipe cards render in batches of 20; card photos are off by default, remote/source-world images are lazy/on-demand, and temporary object URLs are released after image load.
cuisineRoadmapPolicy: Only fully reviewed cuisine libraries appear in the live cuisine selector; planned cuisines remain hidden until their recipes pass quality review.
qualityGate: Full production QA plus v25 expansion gate: Japanese and Filipino additions require complete ingredients, equipment, allergens, references, recipe-specific photo queries, consistent prep/cook/total timing, meaningful doneness cues, recommended serving defaults, and comprehensive variable-length instructions with no artificial 5- or 6-step cap.
servingScalePolicy: Recipe detail opens at each recipe recommended serving count. User adjustments scale ordinary measurable ingredients linearly, while salt and pepper-style seasoning stays at the base amount below 2x and scales when the recipe reaches 2x or more.
allergenPolicy: Allergen metadata is merged with ingredient-based inference for soy, gluten, egg, milk, fish, shellfish, nuts, sesame and coconut. Plant milks and nut butters are excluded from false dairy detection.

standardCuisines.hierarchy: Japanese > Filipino > every other standard cuisine

methodDepth.policy: No fixed step count. The recipe itself determines the number of numbered steps.

v25Expansion.hierarchy: Japanese > Filipino > Korean > Thai > Chinese by current counts
v25Expansion.photoProviderCheck: Wikimedia indexed spot-check passed; bulk CI API requests are avoided because Wikimedia rate-limits burst audit traffic

cookingExperience: Recipe detail defaults to the recipe's recommended serving size; cooking mode includes step-specific ingredient cues, timer suggestions, doneness/texture guidance, equipment/details, allergens and accuracy/reference disclosure.
cleanupRelease: v24.1 completes a seven-library recipe QA. Methods are not authored toward a 5- or 6-step ceiling; simple dishes remain concise while complex dishes retain the stages needed to cook them reliably.
chineseRelease: v24.0 re-reviews all 40 existing Chinese recipes for full cookable method depth while preserving stable IDs, Chinese names, pinyin, regions and search metadata.
thaiRelease: v24.0 adds 60 reviewed Thai recipes without a cuisine-size cap, spanning Central, Northern/Lanna, Isan/Northeastern and Southern Thai cooking, street food, breakfast, desserts and drinks.
fullQaRelease: v25.0 adds 40 Japanese and 20 Filipino gap-driven recipes after per-recipe expansion QA, restores Japanese as the largest cuisine and Filipino as second-largest, and hardens allergen inference for nut butters.
